## Audit & Assurance

Statutory and voluntary audits. AI tests whole populations; people judge and sign.

**Sells:** engagement fee. **Minimum review:** elevated.

**Who signs the deliverable:** internal use: partner; external reliance: partner; regulatory: partner and quality reviewer.

- Audit fees may not depend on outcomes, so no outcome-linked fees.
- The client is billed a fixed engagement fee; the two lines are an internal measure.
- Every audit opinion is signed by the engagement partner and an engagement quality reviewer.

### Journal-entry testing

Audit area signed off: fraud-risk criteria, full-population results, follow-up and conclusion. Relied on at least as regulatory.

| | Milestone | Lane | Led by | Share of Judgment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| M1 | Population completeness and data ingestion | AI-led, spot-checked | junior | 15% |
| M2 | Fraud-risk criteria (blind) | Human-led, blind first pass | junior | 30% |
| M3 | Anomaly review | AI drafts, person confirms | junior | 35% |
| M4 | Follow-up and conclusion | Human-led | manager | 20% |

AI scores 100% of journal entries; the auditor sets the fraud-risk criteria blind, before seeing the scores.

## Consulting

Operating model, technology and transformation.

**Sells:** classic, per deliverable, retainer, outcome linked. **Minimum review:** standard. **Fees at risk:** up to 20% of Judgment.

**Who signs the deliverable:** internal use: manager; external reliance: partner; regulatory: partner and quality reviewer.

- Up to 20% of the Judgment line may be at risk against a KPI baseline the client measures.
- Payment ramps between threshold and target and is capped; the Signature line is never at risk.

### Operating-model diagnostic

Baseline KPIs, root causes, recommendations and a sequenced roadmap. Relied on at least as internal use. Outcome-linked fees allowed.

| | Milestone | Lane | Led by | Share of Judgment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| M1 | Data and interview synthesis | AI drafts, person edits | junior | 20% |
| M2 | Baseline KPIs | Human-led | manager | 20% |
| M3 | Root causes (blind) | Human-led, blind first pass | junior | 30% |
| M4 | Recommendations and roadmap | Human-led | manager | 30% |
